ideas.pitch: A multilingual AI voice and text agent providing localized preventive health guidance, vaccine schedules, and outbreak alerts for rural communities.
ideas.title: ArogyaSetu Rural Health Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact blueprint of Sagacity by solving a real social impact problem with local health data and voice accessibility, which heavily appeals to community-focused judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent sustainability platform calculating optimal low-emission transit routes and daily carbon offsets for university campuses.
ideas.title: EcoRoute Campus Carbon Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a LangGraph multi-agent backend with verifiable real-world utility, echoing the GreenNovation Hackathon winning strategy.

ideas.pitch: A geo-tagged civic reporting platform that automatically categorizes community infrastructure complaints using vision models and generates live council dashboards.
ideas.title: CivicPulse Real-World Issue Mapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements the winning formula from the Chatswood AI Impact Hackathon by connecting daily citizen issues directly to a functional municipal dashboard demo.

ideas.pitch: An AI trust engine that generates verified educational dental and medical content for local clinics to improve patient onboarding and transparency.
ideas.title: MediTrust Patient Acquisition Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the fast-paced, practical architecture seen in Global-Smile's 12-hour sprint win, focusing on immediate economic and trust value for small practitioners.

ideas.pitch: A predictive data dashboard utilizing regression modeling to forecast campus safety risks and resource allocation bottlenecks based on historical event logs.
ideas.title: Campus SafeGuard Incident Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses rigorous statistical forecasting methods similar to the Apart Research AI Forecasting winner, displaying deep technical depth in a short timeframe.
